message.content: {"winner":"B","evidence_A":"Covers subject, journal, period, three stages and all three critique groups. Defects: stray Chinese token «干脆», missing quotes/hyphens. Final claim of «эволюция научной полемики от эмоциональных выпадов к попытке системного анализа» slightly reframes the source. Length is about 95 words, an overshoot of roughly 22%, within tolerance.","evidence_B":"Accurate three stages with dates, method, and journal. Omits the explicit three groups of claims, notably the critique of the USSR experience, though it mentions theoretical and international issues. Length is about 70 words, near target. Clean Russian. The phrase «тематических статей, рецензий и разделов» is supported by the text.","comparative_reason":"A is more complete on the three groups but contains a foreign-language artifact and a mildly embellished conclusion.
